dedupe_keys.name: agcom osservatorio sulle comunicazioni quarterly italian communications market monitoring with open data

description: The Osservatorio sulle comunicazioni (Communication Markets Monitoring System) is AGCOM's quarterly publication on the Italian communications markets. For electronic communications it covers fixed network lines, broadband and ultra-broadband lines by technology and operator, average daily data traffic, weekly data traffic intensity and download and upload traffic, and for mobile networks total subscribers by customer and contract type and data traffic; further sections cover media and internet platforms (audiences from Auditel, ADS, Audiweb and Comscore), postal and parcel services, and price indices from Istat and Eurostat, with annual revenue series from AGCOM's annual report. Figures in the telecom and postal sections come from the main companies. Each issue is published as an Italian PDF (1.9 MB for issue 2/2026, released on 31 July 2026 with data to March 2026), an English PDF of 49 pages and an 'OPEN DATA' Excel workbook (about 0.5 MB). Coverage: Italy. Format and access: PDF and XLSX, free from AGCOM's website. Caveats: operator-reported data; AGCOM notes that changes in firms' accounting mean some figures cannot be compared with earlier issues; licence terms for the open data were not stated on the page read. Simulation uses: quarterly line counts by technology and traffic patterns for demand and capacity models of Italian fixed and mobile networks. Related records: the AGCOM broadband map gives coverage, and Misurainternet gives measured speeds.
